lastResponse.text: Call nine one one now if you’re in immediate danger. If you can talk for even a minute, call 9-8-8 next and say: “I’m being controlled and forced to do sex work. I need a safe exit plan in Oregon City.” You don’t need papers to ask for help. You can share only what feels safe. If this phone dies, borrow any phone and dial 9-8-8 again.
